definitions: A representation of the external form of a person or thing in art.
An optical likeness of an object produced by a mirror or lens.
The general impression that a person, organization, or product presents to the public.
A vivid description or representation of something in speech or writing.
examples: The image of the queen was on the coin.
He saw his image in the mirror.
The company is trying to improve its public image.
The poet used powerful images to describe the scene.
